Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
hi LSJ !
i need your help on this :

Two vamps in combat : Lambach and Beast (i love those mini scenarii)
Beast is *Blocking*
before range, Beast plays Torn signpost, raising strength to 4
Ranges stays close. Lambach then plays sup "Blood of Acid".
Strike declaration : Lambach plays sup "Scorpion Sting".
Can then Beast play a "behind you" -Strike : Dodge, with no effect, to avoid
being burned ?
or is he commited to play something other than dodge by sup. scorpion sting
?
I think the former but... hey, you're the net rep, you know it all =)

keep up the good work
reyda

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <9c0243$2pj$1...@news2.isdnet.net>, Reyda <re...@noos.fr> writes

>Strike declaration : Lambach plays sup "Scorpion Sting".
>Can then Beast play a "behind you" -Strike : Dodge, with no effect, to avoid
>being burned ?
>or is he commited to play something other than dodge by sup. scorpion sting
>?

You cannot dodge; you are prohibited from playing one for no effect.

Similarly, under Immortal Grapple, you cannot cycle cards to no effect.

--

Scorpion Sting says "This strike cannot be dodged," not "the opposing
minion may not dodge," yes?

>
> Similarly, under Immortal Grapple, you cannot cycle cards to no effect.

Which specifically restricts strikes by card text. Not as clear with
Scorpion Sting.
